intro.title: refav1's planner, watched: four cost geometries, one scene
lines: Every frame below shows the SAME moment of the SAME drive, planned FOUR ways. One checkpoint (step 21,109), one world model, one set of decision heads - the arms differ ONLY in what the planner's cost charges for.
GREEN   the GROUND TRUTH - what the human actually drove.
WHITE   the ha0_ext FLOOR - do nothing: hold the measured speed and curvature. This is the line to beat, and it is drawn WIDE and UNDERNEATH, so an arm that sits on it shows the white as a halo.
MAGENTA ccos_argmax - no curvature charge at all. It is the arm that TURNS.
CYAN    combined - the same cost, plus a physics cap: |kappa| <= mu*g/v^2 at mu = 0.7, the friction circle.
ORANGE  wk15 - a curvature CHARGE in the cost (W_KAPPA 15.11).
VIOLET  best - that charge AND the physics cap together.

On a bending road the magenta line swings across the lane; the cyan one bends less; the orange and violet ones barely leave the white floor. The green ground truth goes round the corner without any of them.

MEASURED on this panel: 8 episodes, 40 scored windows, dt 0.2 s, K = 10 (a 2.0 s plan). Feasibility on the 27 windows at v0 >= 2 m/s - the same exclusion raw/feas_audit.py uses, because below it kappa = a_lat/v^2 is ill-conditioned and even the ground truth reads max|kappa| 31.4.
OPEN LOOP throughout (PI ruling 2026-09-02): the model controls nothing; the ego data keeps arriving from the recording.
THE FOUR ARMS DRAWN, MEASURED OVER ALL 40 WINDOWS
ccos_argmax (ccos W_KAPPA 0):   ADE 1.3272 m   ·   max|kappa| 0.2000 1/m   ·   29.6 % of windows OUTSIDE the friction circle (peak 3.262 g)   ·   27.5 % of plans dead straight

combined (ccos W_KAPPA 0 + Kamm cap mu=0.7 + seed ladder):   ADE 1.0504 m   ·   max|kappa| 0.1505 1/m   ·   0.0 % of windows OUTSIDE the friction circle (peak 0.618 g)   ·   27.5 % of plans dead straight
wk15 (ccos W_KAPPA 15.1125):   ADE 0.8934 m   ·   max|kappa| 0.0800 1/m   ·   0.0 % of windows OUTSIDE the friction circle (peak 0.332 g)   ·   47.5 % of plans dead straight
best (ccos W_KAPPA 15.1125 + Kamm cap mu=0.7):   ADE 0.8838 m   ·   max|kappa| 0.0800 1/m   ·   0.0 % of windows OUTSIDE the friction circle (peak 0.332 g)   ·   37.5 % of plans dead straight

ha0_ext FLOOR (do nothing - hold the measured speed and curvature):   ADE 0.8772 m   ·   it BEATS all four, and it is itself outside the circle on 18.5 % of windows (it holds a MEASURED curvature, which is noisy)
GROUND TRUTH (the human):   ADE 0.0000 m by definition   ·   max|kappa| 0.1701 1/m   ·   0.0 % outside the circle   <- THE CONTROL: a real vehicle's recorded motion MUST read 0.0 %, and it does

outro.title: What the reel showed
lines: 1. THE ARM THAT TURNS DRIVES WORST. ccos_argmax reaches |kappa| 0.2000 1/m - exactly the 0.2 clip - and scores ADE 1.3272 m, the worst of the four. It leaves the friction circle on 29.6 % of windows, peaking at 3.262 g - a turn no tyre can take.

2. PHYSICS FIXES THE SAFETY WITHOUT KILLING THE TURN. combined keeps the same cost and adds the Kamm cap: max|kappa| 0.1505, ADE 1.0504 m, and 0.0 % outside the circle - peak 0.618 g. It still turns (72 % of its plans are not straight); it just cannot turn impossibly.

3. CHARGING FOR CURVATURE BUYS ACCURACY BY NOT STEERING. wk15 scores ADE 0.8934 m and best 0.8838 m - the two best in the panel - and they get there with max|kappa| 0.0800 and 47.5 % of plans DEAD STRAIGHT, against 27.5 % for the arm that turns.

This panel carries only 2 GT-left and 2 GT-right windows - far too few to quote a turn recall, and none is quoted here. The powered turn-recall numbers live on the stratified --window-list panel in RESULT.md 7.5.

4. AND THE DO-NOTHING FLOOR BEATS ALL FOUR. ha0_ext - hold the measured speed and curvature, no search, no model - scores ADE 0.8772 m against the best arm's 0.8838 m. The planner has not yet earned its compute.
THE WORLD MODEL - AND THIS PART IS WORKING

Over all 40 windows the predictor beats the persistence control on 28/30 of its 0.2 s steps: it LOSES by 0.0809 at 0.2 s and WINS by 0.3168 at 6.0 s, monotonically. The defect this reel shows is in the PLANNER's cost geometry, not in the model's ability to predict the world.
THE CONTROL THAT LICENSES EVERY FRAME

The recorded actions, integrated through the SAME unicycle every arm was rolled through, land on the dumped ground truth to 0.1552 m mean (median 0.1512, max 0.2981) over the 27 admissible windows - while the same actions under the legacy KAPPA unit reading miss by 0.8727 m, a 5.62x separation. Both halves are required: without the second, a loose tolerance would pass anything. See the _GT_CONTROL.png beside this file.

MEASURED 2026-09-05/06 from ...Research/2026-09-05-refav1-cost-geometry/raw/arms/. Tier T1 (self-action open loop). n = 40 windows / 8 episode clusters - too few for a decision-grade interval, and no interval is claimed here: this reel is a PICTURE of a banked panel, not a new result.
